task.description: Produce a backend design artefact for ADP-12 at src/design/adp-12-default-tenant-regression-suite.md. Design an automated regression suite that executes Stage 1-6 default-tenant endpoint coverage before and after the adaptation migration and enforces zero-diff response invariants (status, body, and headers excluding explicitly allowed informational fields). Define capture/canonicalization strategy, deterministic comparison rules, flaky-signal controls, fixture/data seeding assumptions, migration boundary orchestration, and CI/report artifact format. Include exact mapping from ADP-12 acceptance criteria to executable tests and identify backend touchpoints required for implementation. Design only; no implementation edits.
acceptance_criteria: Design defines pre-migration and post-migration execution phases with deterministic orchestration
Canonical diff rules specify exactly what is compared and what is excluded
Coverage matrix maps Stage 1-6 endpoints and default-tenant execution paths
Design includes report format and pass/fail criteria for byte-equal response validation
Design provides acceptance-to-test traceability for ADP-12

result.summary: Design artefact for ADP-12 default-tenant regression suite, including deterministic pre/post migration orchestration, canonical diff policy, Stage 1-6 endpoint coverage matrix, report format, flaky controls, and acceptance-to-test traceability.
